description: This Java class implements a specific loan repayment schedule transaction processor following the 'Fineract-style'. It defines methods to handle different types of loan repayment transactions including on-time, early, late, and refund transactions, paying interest first then principal, and also manages components like charges and penalties. The class extends an abstract processor and specifies a particular repayment strategy within the Fineract financial platform context.

classes.name: FineractStyleLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: Implements a loan repayment strategy that processes interest and principal payments in a defined order, handles various transaction types, and extends the abstract transaction processor for Fineract-based loan management systems.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the strategy code identifier for this loan repayment processor.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of the repayment strategy.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes early payments by treating them as on-time payments, paying interest first then principal.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes late repayments similar to on-time payments with interest paid first.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles normal, on-time repayments, paying off interest first, then principal, and managing charge components.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles refund transactions, removing principal, interest, and charges in order.
